Coram : MARKANDEY KATJU, H.L. DATTU
REGULATIONS FRAMED UNDER UTTAR PRADESH INTERMEDIATE EDUCATION ACT, 1921: c r.61(2)(b) - Seniority of a transferee teacher - Held: A teacher, on being transferred on his own request, would be placed at the bottom of the seniority list of teachers serving on the same cadre in the transferee sought voluntary transfer was rightly placed at the bottom in the seniority list of the transferee college - Judgment of High Court set aside - Writ petition of teacher concerned dismissed. CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION : Civil Appeal No. E 2766 of 2009. From the Judgment & Order dated
